name: the merge-form guard matches every button again
why: Without the btn.type check, initNavigationGuard()'s merge-form arm fires on the per-column Cc/Rx/Ex chips of a single-table page (the table sits inside MusicBrainz's merge <form>): a native 'You are about to leave this page' confirm on every chip click, and a Cancel swallows the click.
grep: inside the merge form a chip raises no leave-page prompt

name: the merge-form guard is dropped instead of narrowed
why: The lazy fix for the chip prompt is to stop guarding merge forms at all. Then a real merge submit navigates away and throws the whole loaded session away without asking.
